subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins

question: Should this broader branch become the canonical fix after it adds exact-head live state-preservation proof, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 land with a separate follow-up for the update-check parser?
rationale: Both branches address the destructive lifecycle bug, but only this PR includes both npm 12 parser surfaces while only the competing PR currently claims a real CLI state-transition run; automation cannot choose the canonical branch or supply contributor-environment proof.

options.title: Prove and land this branch
options.body: Require a redacted exact-head update-repair or plugin-update transcript showing entries, activation lists, and slots remain intact, then close the narrower competitor.

options.title: Land the narrower competitor
options.body: Use the proof-positive lifecycle patch in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 and track the remaining update-check singleton-array parser fix separately.

options.title: Consolidate the branches
options.body: Adopt the strongest implementation and proof into one branch before closing the duplicate landing candidate.

recommendation.title: Prove and land this branch
recommendation.body: Require a redacted exact-head update-repair or plugin-update transcript showing entries, activation lists, and slots remain intact, then close the narrower competitor.
